liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Help on the Way** (3 reviews): Opener hits hard, with the band audibly eager during tuning before launching in; Garcia's guitar in this opener sounds acoustic to the reviewer [21][22][26]
- **Dark Star** (2 reviews): Estimated Prophet flows into a Dark Star with only one verse sung; Estimated Prophet leading into Dark Star is called a record-book pairing [21][22]
- **Birdsong** (1 review): Features David Murrey on saxophone [25]
- **Turn on your Lovelight** (1 other source): James Cotton joined on harmonica [2]
- **I Fought The Law** (1 other source): James Cotton played harmonica on the encore [2]

## Setlist highlights

- **Load Check**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [31]
- **Tapers Comments**: back after 183 archived shows (879 days); mythic rare: 2 archived performances [31]

## The recordings

- **gd1993-09-22.fob.GEMS.91805.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 19 songs; 180 min [1]
- **gd93-09-22.ST250s.brennecke-young.4533.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 17 songs; 166 min; rated 3.78/5 by 9 [11]. Said about its sound: Audience recording's opening track has about seven minutes with no music before the show begins; As audience recordings go, it is nearly perfect, though vocals run loud; Drums come across a bit loud in this song [28][29]
- **gd1993-09-22.sbd.murray-yubah.77070.shnf**: soundboard; 17 songs; 151 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [14]
- **gd1993-09-22.172437.mtx.eichorn.flac1648**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 17 songs; 150 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [15]
- **gd93-09-22.sbd.yubah.565.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 151 min; rated 3.65/5 by 34 [17]. Said about its sound: Soundboard stream of first set is rich, with Garcia's guitar notes sounding deep and saturated; Garcia's acoustic-like tone is attributed to a pedal or processor that made his electric guitar sound acoustic; Soundboard sound is solid overall [20][23][26][27][30]

## Around the show

- Dave Murray sat in as guest; reviewer wanted longer jams with him [20]
- Reviewer watched from a skybox; rain seemed to come down heavily inside the arena later [22]
- This was the final night of a six-night run at the Garden [25]
- At the start of the tape, the tapers are making bets on the setlist [29]
- At the start of the tape, the tapers are making bets on the setlist [30]
- David Murray played saxophone on Birdsong and throughout the entire second set [2]
- David Murray on saxophone from Birdsong onward except the encore; James Cotton on harmonica for Lovelight [14]
- Only two later Dark Stars followed: Rosemont Horizon, Illinois on 03-16-94 and the Omni, Atlanta on 03-30-94 [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1993-09-22.fob.GEMS.91805.flac16**: taped by James Young & Clay Brennecke; transferred by Jamie Waddell; source: Soundfield AMS ST-250 Microphone using Blumlein configuration. Both sets recorded on stand (at 6'3") > Panasonic SV 255. [1]
- **gd93-09-22.ST250s.brennecke-young.4533.sbeok.shnf**: taped by James Young and Clay Brennecke; source: Audience: AMS ST-250 [11]. Also: Audience taping made from thirteenth row center by two experienced tapers [25]
- **gd1993-09-22.sbd.murray-yubah.77070.shnf**: transferred by yubah; source: SBD:DAT-> CDR [14]. Also: Seeded by an anonymous source, with DAT masters supplied by David Murray; uploader re-tracked the discs [14]
- **gd1993-09-22.172437.mtx.eichorn.flac1648**: source: 2-Source Matrix (16/48) by RE Eichorn (July 2025) [15]. Also: New matrix by the uploader, using newer, better sources, replacing his earlier 2013 matrixes of this show [15]
- **gd93-09-22.sbd.yubah.565.sbeok.shnf**: source: DSBD> DAT> CDR> EAC> WAV> SHN [17]
